name: Next.js + Postgres
tagline: A Next.js 15 guestbook on managed Postgres, with Server Actions.
description: Sign the guestbook and your entry appears at once: Next.js 15 with the App Router, React 19 and TypeScript, a Server Action for the write, and managed Postgres behind it. It builds without a database, connects over velixir's TLS the way node-postgres needs, and shows a setup page instead of crashing when no database is bound. Deploying it creates a managed Postgres and connects it for you.
